notes: IRPEF brackets: three-bracket structure per L. 199/2025 (Legge di Bilancio 2026); second bracket reduced from 35% to 33% effective 2026-01-01.
work_deduction_breakpoints: Art. 13 co. 1 TUIR, as modified by D.Lgs. 216/2023 and confirmed by L. 207/2024.

INPS rates: credito sector (Credito e Assicurazioni). Rates confirmed from kitech.it 2026 Table 6.1 (https://www.kitech.it/Contributi-previdenziali.aspx?p=9_165): dirigenti and operai/impiegati 35.95% total = 9.19% employee + 26.76% employer. No size tiers (flat structure corroborated by absence of size-tier pages for credito on kitech.it). NOTE: kitech.it shows 'salariati' at 38.50% total (29.31% employer); this category (hourly auxiliary workers) is not present in standard credito CCNLs and is not modelled. SIMPLIFICATION: Fondo di solidarietà del credito (D.Lgs. 148/2015, bilateral fund substituting CIG/CIGS; ordinary rate 0.50% total: ~0.33% employer + ~0.17% employee) is presumed aggregated into the 26.76%/9.19% kitech.it totals. If the fund is reported separately by the employer, actual INPS rates would be 26.43% employer and 9.02% employee (IVS+NASpI only), and the 0.33%/0.17% must be remitted on top — verify against INPS circular for Fondo credito.
fixed_term_additional_rate: NASpI addizionale base rate 1.4% (employer-only) per Art. 2 co. 28 L. 92/2012.

INPS dipendente — employee_rate 9.19% flat confirmed (kitech.it 2026); includes IVS employee share + NASpI employee share. Fondo di solidarietà employee share (if not included in 9.19%) would be an additional ~0.17% — see SIMPLIFICATION note above.

Apprentice contributions (L. 296/2006 art. 1 c. 773; L. 92/2012 art. 2 c. 36-37): employer 10% + NASpI 1.31% + 0.30% = 11.61%; employee 5.84%. Firms with at most 9 employees pay 1.5% (+1.61% NASpI) in months 0-11 and 3% (+1.61%) in months 12-23, then 11.61%. SIMPLIFICATION: hiring incentives (sgravi) and Cassa Edile apprentice schemes are not modelled.

IVS ceiling: massimale annuo della base contributiva 2026 = EUR 122,295.00 (INPS Circ. 6/2026, 30 Jan 2026, Art. 1 L. 335/1995 c. 18). Applies only when ivs_ceiling_applies=True (workers enrolled in INPS on or after 1 Jan 1996).

Sterilizzazione detrazioni: Art. 1 c. 3-4 L. 199/2025 — for reddito complessivo > EUR 200 000, total detrazioni (Art. 12 + Art. 13 TUIR) reduced by EUR 440 (clawback of the 35% -> 33% bracket benefit on the 28 000-50 000 slice).
